items.description: Report does not state whether the stranded remainder sits in the contract's ETH balance or an L1 account, so the exact storage location of the unaccounted value is implementation-dependent.
Report does not state whether the stranded remainder sits in the contract's ETH balance or an L1 account, so the exact storage location of stranded_amount cannot be bound.
Permanent lock and accumulation are described as potential/accumulating rather than observed in a concrete transaction; the conservation relation is asserted at the per-call amount level.
